sections.content: CSS colors accept names (red), hex (#ff0000), rgb()/rgba(), hsl(), and modern oklch. The background shorthand sets color, image, position, and repeat.
Contrast matters: body text needs ~4.5:1 against its background for readability (WCAG AA).
Key points: rgba adds transparency, gradients via linear-gradient(), and CSS variables keep palettes consistent.
